newsitem.title: USA: Essex Corp to restructure, shed units.
newsitem.headline: Essex Corp to restructure, shed units.

text.p: Essex Corp said on Monday it is negotiating to sell its technical service business to help restore it to a positive equity status.
The company said in a news release that as of June 29 it had negative working capital of $600,000.
Essex said it is reorganizing to focus on its optoelectronics products and services business and satellite telecommunications engineering services.
Business areas to be sold include submarine engineering, human factors engineering and nuclear transportation safeguards.
The company also said it is closing a facility in Huntsville, Ala.
Essex reported a second-quarter loss of $0.15 per share, compared with a loss of $0.14 per share for the same period a year ago.
The company said it expected to have "a positive equity" after selling its discontinued operations.
